title.zh-CN: 血糖偏低 · 生后11小时女婴

summary.zh-CN: 足月女婴，出生体重4.05 kg，生后11小时发现血糖偏低。
summary.en: A term baby girl who weighed 4.05 kg at birth is found to have a low blood glucose at 11 hours of age.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对反复发作的新生儿低血糖立即静脉补糖：10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg静推后持续输注、按糖速调整（AAP 2011），并在低血糖时留取关键标本而不推迟治疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat recurrent neonatal hypoglycaemia at once — 10% glucose 2 mL/kg IV, then a continuous infusion adjusted by glucose infusion rate (AAP 2011) — and take the critical sample during a low without delaying treatment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南判读关键标本：血糖<2.8 mmol/L时胰岛素和C肽可测得、β-羟丁酸<1.8 mmol/L支持胰岛素过多；疑似持续性低血糖症时把血糖维持在3.9 mmol/L以上（PES 2015），并与过渡期低血糖、垂体功能低下和脂肪酸氧化障碍相鉴别。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a critical sample by the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline — measurable insulin and C-peptide with β-hydroxybutyrate < 1.8 mmol/L at a glucose < 2.8 mmol/L — keep glucose above 3.9 mmol/L once a persistent disorder is suspected (PES 2015), and tell it from transitional hypoglycaemia, hypopituitarism and fatty-acid oxidation disorders.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在有房间隔缺损和动脉导管未闭的婴儿中安全开始二氮嗪：低剂量起始、合用噻嗪类利尿剂、监测液体平衡和肺动脉高压（FDA 2015；PES 2020），并用院内监护下的禁食试验判断疗效，绝不在家禁食。
learningOutcomes.en: Start diazoxide safely in an infant with an atrial septal defect and a patent ductus — a low starting dose with a thiazide, and fluid and pulmonary-hypertension surveillance (FDA 2015; PES 2020) — and judge the response by a supervised fast in hospital, never a fast at home.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 二氮嗪无效时尽快送检患儿及父母双方的ABCC8/KCNJ11，转诊至专科中心做¹⁸F-DOPA PET，并解释为什么超声或MRI正常不能排除局灶病灶（2024年国际指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: When diazoxide fails, send urgent ABCC8/KCNJ11 testing for the baby and both parents, refer for ¹⁸F-DOPA PET at a specialist centre, and explain why a normal ultrasound or MRI cannot exclude a focal lesion (2024 international guideline).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对局灶型病变选择¹⁸F-DOPA PET引导、术中冰冻切片确认切缘的局部胰腺切除，而不是近全胰切除，并说明两种手术各自的后果。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose a PET-guided limited pancreatectomy with frozen-section margins over near-total pancreatectomy for focal disease, and state the consequences of each.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向家属解释父母都未检出的变异对局灶机制和再生育的意义，并制定术后随访：禁食试验确认痊愈、神经发育评估和遗传咨询。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain to the family what a variant found in neither parent means for the focal mechanism and for future pregnancies, and plan follow-up: a fast to confirm cure, neurodevelopmental assessment and genetic counselling.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：女婴，生后11小时出现低血糖，此后多次血糖低于2.8 mmol/L；足月顺产，出生体重4.05 kg，无窒息；母亲孕期健康、无糖耐量异常史；父母非近亲，无低血糖或糖尿病家族史；低血糖时标本（血糖1.8 mmol/L、胰岛素11 μU/mL、C肽0.74 nmol/L、β-羟丁酸0.5 mmol/L）；胰腺超声和头颅及垂体MRI无异常；心脏超声示房间隔缺损、动脉导管未闭、轻度三尖瓣反流；甲状腺功能和ACTH正常；用过二氮嗪和奥曲肽后仍频繁低血糖；ABCC8 c.1792C>T（报告写作p.Arg598X），父母该位点正常，KCNJ11未见异常；¹⁸F-DOPA定位胰体远端12.2 mm×9.5 mm病灶；局灶部分切除，病理证实局灶型；三个月时空腹血糖约4.4–6.0 mmol/L、餐后约7 mmol/L。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、地点和日历日期已去除，时间以生后小时数和病程阶段表示。陪同家属的身份、全部对话、阶段划分、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容保持未知。保留的存疑之处：血氨所附单位存疑，1.0.0版未收录其数值；“三个月”未说明是月龄还是术后三个月；转诊时的年龄没有记录；父母均未检出该变异，与局灶型常见的父源遗传不同，待对照原文核对。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: a baby girl with hypoglycaemia from 11 hours of age and repeated readings below 2.8 mmol/L afterwards; term vaginal birth, 4.05 kg, no asphyxia; a mother healthy in pregnancy with no history of glucose intolerance; non-consanguineous parents with no family history of hypoglycaemia or diabetes; the sample taken during hypoglycaemia (glucose 1.8 mmol/L, insulin 11 µU/mL, C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L, β-hydroxybutyrate 0.5 mmol/L); unremarkable pancreatic ultrasound and brain and pituitary MRI; an echocardiogram with an atrial septal defect, a patent ductus arteriosus and mild tricuspid regurgitation; normal thyroid function and ACTH; frequent hypoglycaemia despite diazoxide and octreotide; ABCC8 c.1792C>T (written p.Arg598X in the report), normal at this position in the parents, with no KCNJ11 abnormality; ¹⁸F-DOPA localisation of a 12.2 × 9.5 mm lesion in the distal pancreatic body; a focal partial resection with histology confirming focal disease; and fasting glucose of about 4.4–6.0 mmol/L and post-meal glucose of about 7 mmol/L at three months. They have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, places and calendar dates are removed, and times are hours of life and stages of the course. Who the relative is, all dialogue, the phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record stays unknown. Points kept open: the ammonia was reported with a doubtful unit and its value is not in version 1.0.0; “three months” does not say whether it is her age or the time after surgery; her age at referral is not recorded; and a variant found in neither parent differs from the paternal inheritance usual in focal disease — all to be checked against the article.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 护士说孩子的血糖偏低
chiefComplaint.en: The nurse says her blood sugar is low

triageNote.zh-CN: 生后11小时女婴，足月顺产，出生体重4.05 kg，出生时无窒息。刚刚发现她的血糖偏低。家属在床旁陪护。
triageNote.en: Girl aged 11 hours, born at term by vaginal delivery, birth weight 4.05 kg, no asphyxia at birth. Her glucose has just been found to be low. A relative is at the cot side.

personality.zh-CN: 足月出生的小婴儿，还不会说话；一直由陪在小床边的家属代她回答。
personality.en: A baby girl born at term who cannot talk yet; the relative at her cot answers for her throughout.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 她不会说话；家属用日常口语回答，转述护士和医生说过的话和数字，不用医学术语，记不清的就直说记不清。
speechStyle.en: She does not speak; her relative answers in everyday words, passing on what the nurses and doctors have said, including their numbers, without medical terms, and says so when unsure.

openingLine.zh-CN: （家属）医生，护士刚给她测了血糖，说偏低。她才生下来11个小时，这要不要紧？
openingLine.en: (Relative) Doctor, the nurse has just checked her sugar and says it's low. She's only 11 hours old — is that serious?

concerns.zh-CN: 血糖低会不会伤到她的脑子。
concerns.en: Whether the low sugar could harm her brain.

concerns.zh-CN: 是不是怀孕的时候哪里没做好，才让她这样。
concerns.en: Whether something in the pregnancy caused it.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者须知：婴儿不说话，所有问题由家属回答。家属着急、疲惫，但愿意配合，常常追问“要不要紧”；只讲自己知道或听孩子妈妈、护士和医生说过的事，检查结果和诊断留给医生说。每个阶段只谈到那一阶段为止发生的事：第一阶段只知道生后11小时测得血糖偏低；之后才知道又低了好几次；更晚的经过只在病例进入相应阶段后才提。本病例没有记录的事（低血糖时的表现、喂养、用药剂量、以后的发育等）就直说说不上来，不要编。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the baby does not speak, and the relative answers every question — anxious and tired but cooperative, often asking whether it is serious; they say only what they know or have heard from the baby's mother, the nurses and the doctors, and leave results and the diagnosis to the doctors. In each phase they speak only of what has happened by then: in the first phase they know only that her glucose was low at 11 hours; only later that it has dropped again several times; anything later is mentioned only once the case reaches that phase. Whatever the case does not record (how she was during the lows, her feeding, drug doses, her later development) they say they cannot tell, and never invent.

persona.zh-CN: 孩子的近亲属，从出生起就陪着她；具体是哪位亲属本病例没有记录，不要另加设定。着急、疲惫，但愿意配合；用日常口语回答，只讲自己知道或听孩子妈妈、护士和医生说过的事；数字记不清就直说，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: A close relative who has been with the baby since birth; which relative is not recorded, so add nothing. Anxious and tired but cooperative; answers in everyday words, saying only what they know or have heard from the baby's mother, the nurses and the doctors; admits forgetting numbers and draws no medical conclusions.

nonVerbalReason.zh-CN: 还是个小婴儿，不会说话
nonVerbalReason.en: a young baby who cannot talk yet

message.en: This report can be read only at the referral and specialist-test stage.

name.en: Insert an IV cannula and take bloods

dose.zh-CN: 新生儿外周静脉留置针（必要时脐静脉置管），置管时同时留取血标本。
dose.en: A neonatal peripheral cannula (an umbilical venous catheter if needed), taking blood samples as it goes in.

response.zh-CN: 静脉通路已建立，血标本已留取。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV access is in and the bloods are taken. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg（200 mg/kg），数分钟内静脉推注，随即开始持续输注；之后复测血糖确认回升。
dose.en: 10% glucose 2 mL/kg (200 mg/kg) IV over a few minutes, followed at once by a continuous infusion; recheck the glucose afterwards to confirm it has risen.

response.zh-CN: 已推注。本病例没有记录当年是否静脉补糖、用量多少；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record whether IV glucose was given at the time or how much; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 持续静脉输注葡萄糖，起始糖速约5–8 mg/(kg·min)，按血糖逐步上调；糖速〔mg/(kg·min)〕＝葡萄糖浓度（%）×输注速度（mL/h）÷6÷体重（kg）。疑似持续性低血糖症时目标>3.9 mmol/L；高浓度葡萄糖需经中心静脉。
dose.en: Continuous IV glucose starting at about 5–8 mg/kg/min and stepped up by her glucose; glucose infusion rate (mg/kg/min) = concentration (%) × rate (mL/h) ÷ 6 ÷ weight (kg). Aim above 3.9 mmol/L once a persistent disorder is suspected; concentrated glucose needs a central line.

response.zh-CN: 输注已开始。本病例没有记录当年的输注浓度和糖速；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The infusion is running. This case does not record the concentration or glucose infusion rate used at the time; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 安排频繁的床旁血糖监测
name.en: Set up frequent bedside glucose checks

dose.zh-CN: 每次喂奶前和每次调整治疗后测床旁血糖，结果偏低时立即报告；疑似持续性低血糖症时目标>3.9 mmol/L。
dose.en: Bedside glucose before every feed and after every change in treatment, reporting any low at once; aim above 3.9 mmol/L once a persistent disorder is suspected.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 母乳或配方奶，按需频繁喂养，与静脉葡萄糖同时进行。
dose.en: Breast milk or formula, on demand and often, alongside any IV glucose.

response.zh-CN: 已安排喂养。本病例没有记录她的喂养方式和奶量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Feeds arranged. This case does not record how she was fed or how much; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 没有静脉通路时肌内或皮下注射急救，或静脉持续输注作过渡；剂量按新生儿药物手册和专科意见。
dose.en: IM or SC as rescue when there is no IV access, or a continuous IV infusion as a bridge; dose per the neonatal formulary and specialist advice.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录是否用过胰高血糖素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record whether glucagon was used; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 5–15 mg/(kg·d)，分2–3次口服，新生儿从低端起始；与噻嗪类利尿剂同用。每天称体重、记出入量，复查心脏超声，定期查血象。
dose.en: 5–15 mg/kg/day by mouth in 2–3 doses, starting at the low end in a newborn, with a thiazide alongside. Weigh daily, chart fluids, repeat the echocardiogram and check the blood count regularly.

harm.zh-CN: 二氮嗪只用于证实的胰岛素过多：在低血糖时的标本证实之前就用药，会掩盖诊断，并让婴儿无故承受水钠潴留和肺动脉高压的风险（FDA 2015；PES 2020）。
harm.en: Diazoxide is for proven insulin excess: starting it before a sample taken during a low has shown that hides the diagnosis and exposes the baby to fluid retention and pulmonary hypertension for no reason (FDA 2015; PES 2020).

response.zh-CN: 已开始二氮嗪。本病例记录用过二氮嗪，但没有记录剂量和疗程；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Diazoxide started. This case records that diazoxide was used but not its dose or duration; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 噻嗪类利尿剂（与二氮嗪同用）

dose.zh-CN: 氯噻嗪或氢氯噻嗪口服，按新生儿药物手册剂量，与二氮嗪同时开始；监测电解质和体重。
dose.en: Chlorothiazide or hydrochlorothiazide by mouth at the neonatal formulary dose, started with diazoxide; monitor electrolytes and weight.

response.zh-CN: 已开始利尿剂。本病例没有记录当年是否合用利尿剂；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Diuretic started. This case does not record whether a diuretic was used at the time; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 皮下注射，每日多次或持续皮下输注，作为二线用药，剂量由专科团队确定；观察喂养耐受和腹胀。
dose.en: Subcutaneous injections several times a day or a continuous subcutaneous infusion, as a second-line drug at a dose set by the specialist team; watch feed tolerance and abdominal distension.

harm.zh-CN: 奥曲肽是二氮嗪之后的二线用药：新生儿使用后有坏死性小肠结肠炎的报道（Laje等，2010），而且疗效会很快减弱；一线是二氮嗪（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
harm.en: Octreotide is second-line after diazoxide: necrotising enterocolitis has been reported in newborns given it (Laje et al., 2010) and its effect fades quickly; diazoxide comes first (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例记录用过奥曲肽，之后仍频繁低血糖，但没有记录剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case records that octreotide was used and that frequent lows continued, but not the dose; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 急送基因检测（患儿及父母双方）
name.en: Send urgent genetic tests (baby and both parents)

dose.zh-CN: 按临床问题选择基因组合并写明临床情况；父母双方同时采样，以判断变异的来源。
dose.en: Choose the gene panel for the clinical question and state the clinical picture; sample both parents at the same time so the origin of any variant can be judged.

response.zh-CN: 标本已送检。本病例记录了基因检测结果，在“转诊与专科检查”阶段可以调阅；送检的时间没有记录。
response.en: Samples sent. The case records the genetic result, which can be read at the referral and specialist-test stage; when the samples were sent is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 转诊至有经验的专科中心（内分泌、外科、核医学）
name.en: Refer to an experienced specialist centre (endocrinology, surgery, nuclear medicine)

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系、书面转诊；转运途中继续静脉葡萄糖和血糖监测。
dose.en: Phone and write the referral; keep IV glucose and glucose checks going during the transfer.

response.zh-CN: 已联系转诊。本病例记录她后来转诊，但没有记录转诊时的年龄和去向。
response.en: Referral made. The case records that she was later referred, but not her age at referral or where she went.

name.zh-CN: 按定位结果做部分胰腺切除，术中冰冻切片确认切缘
name.en: Partial pancreatectomy guided by the localisation scan, with frozen sections to check the margins

dose.zh-CN: 由有经验的小儿胰腺外科团队完成；术中送冰冻切片，确认切缘没有病变。
dose.en: By an experienced paediatric pancreatic surgical team, with intraoperative frozen sections to confirm the margins are clear.

harm.zh-CN: 没有定位结果就切胰腺是盲切：可能切不到病灶，或切掉过多正常胰腺。局部切除要以¹⁸F-DOPA PET定位为依据（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
harm.en: Operating without a localisation scan is a blind resection that may miss the lesion or remove too much normal pancreas; a limited resection is planned from the ¹⁸F-DOPA PET (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

response.zh-CN: 已安排手术。报告记录做了局灶部分切除，术后病理证实为局灶型；本病例没有记录手术细节、冰冻切片和切缘。
response.en: Operation arranged. The report records a focal partial resection with histology confirming the focal form; this case does not record the operative details, frozen sections or margins.

name.zh-CN: 院内监护下的禁食试验

dose.zh-CN: 按年龄确定禁食时长，定时测血糖和β-羟丁酸；血糖降到阈值即终止，终止时采血并给糖。用于判断药物疗效、出院前安全和术后是否痊愈。
dose.en: Fast for an age-appropriate time with regular glucose and β-hydroxybutyrate checks; stop at the glucose threshold, taking blood and giving glucose. Used to judge drug response, safety before discharge and cure after surgery.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录是否做过禁食试验；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record whether a fasting test was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 术后随访计划：禁食试验确认痊愈、神经发育随访和遗传咨询
name.en: Follow-up plan: a fast to confirm cure, neurodevelopmental follow-up and genetic counselling

dose.zh-CN: 术后用禁食试验确认不再低血糖；定期随访生长和神经发育；监测血糖和胰腺功能；为父母安排遗传咨询。
dose.en: A fast after surgery to confirm the lows have gone; regular growth and neurodevelopmental review; glucose and pancreatic function monitoring; genetic counselling for the parents.

response.zh-CN: 随访计划已制定。本病例只记录了三个月时的血糖；神经发育、复发和胰腺功能没有记录。
response.en: Follow-up plan made. The case records only her glucose at three months; neurodevelopment, recurrence and pancreatic function are not recorded.

dose.en: 50 % glucose 1–2 mL/kg as a rapid IV push.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：新生儿不用50%葡萄糖。高渗液可致静脉炎、外渗后组织坏死，血糖骤升还会刺激胰岛素反跳、随后再次低血糖，在胰岛素过多时尤其明显；应使用10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg并随即持续输注（AAP 2011）。
harm.en: Dangerous: newborns are not given 50 % glucose. It is hyperosmolar, causes phlebitis and tissue necrosis if it leaks, and the sudden rise triggers rebound insulin release and a further low — worst when insulin is already in excess. Use 10% glucose 2 mL/kg followed by an infusion (AAP 2011).

response.zh-CN: 已推注。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

dose.zh-CN: 氢化可的松静脉或口服，按体重给药，连用数天。
dose.en: Hydrocortisone IV or by mouth, weight-based, for several days.

harm.zh-CN: 没有证实皮质醇缺乏就用激素升血糖，会掩盖诊断（低血糖时应先采血测皮质醇和生长激素），也纠正不了胰岛素过多，还带来感染、高血压和生长抑制等不良反应（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。她的ACTH正常。
harm.en: Steroids to raise the glucose without a proven cortisol deficiency hide the diagnosis (cortisol and growth hormone belong in the sample taken during a low), do not correct insulin excess and add infection, hypertension and poor growth (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). Her ACTH was normal.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录用过激素；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record any steroid; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 让家属在家给她禁食，看能撑多久
name.en: Ask the family to fast her at home to see how long she lasts

dose.zh-CN: 回家后延长两次喂奶的间隔，记录她什么时候出现症状。
dose.en: At home, stretch the gap between feeds and note when she shows symptoms.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：反复低血糖的婴儿在家禁食，可能在没有监测和急救的情况下发生严重低血糖、抽搐和永久性脑损伤。禁食试验只能在院内监护下进行，并预先设定终止标准（PES 2015；2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
harm.en: Dangerous: a baby with recurrent lows fasted at home can have severe hypoglycaemia, seizures and permanent brain injury with nobody monitoring or able to treat. A fast is done only in hospital, supervised, with a pre-set stopping rule (PES 2015; 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

response.zh-CN: 已向家属提出。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Suggested to the family. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 近全胰切除（切除95%–98%的胰腺）

dose.en: Removal of 95–98 % of the pancreatic tissue.

harm.zh-CN: 近全胰切除只用于药物无效的弥漫型，术后常发生糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全；在基因和¹⁸F-DOPA PET结果之前做，或在PET已定位局灶病灶之后做，都会切掉本可保留的胰腺（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
harm.en: Near-total pancreatectomy is for medically unresponsive diffuse disease and commonly leaves diabetes and exocrine insufficiency; done before genetics and ¹⁸F-DOPA PET, or after the PET has localised a focal lesion, it removes pancreas that could have been kept (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录这一手术；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record this operation; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 未做院内禁食试验就带家用血糖仪出院
name.en: Discharge home with a glucose meter without an in-hospital fasting check

dose.zh-CN: 出院回家，多喂奶，在家测血糖，门诊复查。
dose.en: Home with frequent feeds and home glucose checks, reviewed in clinic.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：出院前必须证明她能在与年龄相应的禁食中维持安全的血糖（PES 2015）；在这之前出院，低血糖会发生在家里，可致不可逆的脑损伤。
harm.en: Dangerous: before discharge she must show she can keep a safe glucose through an age-appropriate fast (PES 2015); sent home before that, her lows happen at home and can cause permanent brain injury.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有这样处理；不模拟其后果。
response.en: This case did not do this; it does not simulate the consequences.

title.en: Take the handover and assess the baby

hint.zh-CN: 她出生时的大小、母亲孕期的血糖和家族情况，各自提示了什么风险？你打算多久复测一次血糖？
hint.en: What risk do her size at birth, her mother's glucose in pregnancy and the family history each point to — and how often will you recheck her glucose?

guidance.zh-CN: 到小床边听护士交班，向家属问清出生和孕期经过，评估她的大小，复测床旁血糖并安排后续监测。
guidance.en: At the cot side, take the nurse's handover, ask her relative about the birth and the pregnancy, assess her size, recheck her glucose at the bedside and set up further checks.

title.zh-CN: 让血糖安全，并在血糖低时留取标本
title.en: Make her glucose safe and catch a sample during a low

hint.zh-CN: 低血糖一再出现时，你先做什么、同时做什么？哪一管血必须趁她血糖还低的时候抽？
hint.en: When the lows keep coming back, what do you do first and what alongside it? Which blood has to be drawn while she is still low?

guidance.zh-CN: 问清此后的血糖情况并查看床旁血糖记录，决定并落实处理，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Find out how her glucose has been since, read the bedside glucose record, decide on and carry out her treatment, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.en: Read what the sample taken during the low shows

hint.zh-CN: 她血糖很低的时候，胰岛素、C肽和酮体本该处在什么水平？哪些结果能帮你排除其他原因？
hint.en: When her glucose is very low, where should insulin, C-peptide and ketones be? Which results help you rule out the other causes?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅关键标本和相关化验，判断低血糖的机制，作答决策 2。
guidance.en: Read the critical sample and the related tests, work out the mechanism of her lows and answer decision 2.

title.zh-CN: 安全开始药物治疗并判断疗效
title.en: Start treatment safely and judge the response

hint.zh-CN: 她的心脏超声结果会怎样改变你给药和观察的方式？什么情况下才能说一种药无效，无效之后最急的是什么？
hint.en: How does her echocardiogram change the way you give and watch a medicine? When can you call a medicine a failure, and what is most urgent after that?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看心脏超声，作答决策 3 并开始治疗；进入药物治疗阶段后调阅治疗记录，作答决策 4 并安排下一步。
guidance.en: Read the echocardiogram, answer decision 3 and start treatment; once on treatment, read the treatment record, answer decision 4 and arrange the next step.

title.zh-CN: 解读专科中心的检查并决定治疗
title.en: Read the specialist centre's tests and decide the treatment

hint.zh-CN: 基因结果和影像结果各能回答什么问题？治疗的范围应当由什么来确定？
hint.en: What question does the genetic result answer, and what question does the scan answer? What should decide how far treatment goes?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅基因检测和影像报告，作答决策 5，并安排你选择的治疗。
guidance.en: Read the genetic and scan reports, answer decision 5 and arrange the treatment you chose.

title.zh-CN: 回顾报告记录的转归并制定随访
title.en: Review the recorded outcome and plan follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 短期的血糖结果能说明什么、不能说明什么？还需要随访哪些方面，家里人还需要知道什么？
hint.en: What can a short-term glucose result tell you, and what can it not? What else needs following up, and what does the family still need to know?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅报告记录的治疗、病理和随访，并制定随访计划。
guidance.en: Read the recorded treatment, histology and follow-up, and make the follow-up plan.

prompt.zh-CN: 她生后11小时第一次测到血糖偏低，此后又多次低于2.8 mmol/L（各次数值没有记录）。她足月出生，体重4.05 kg，母亲孕期没有糖耐量异常。现在怎么处理？
prompt.en: Her glucose was first low at 11 hours of age and has since fallen below 2.8 mmol/L several times (the individual values are not recorded). She was born at term weighing 4.05 kg, and her mother had no glucose intolerance in pregnancy. What do you do now?

need.zh-CN: 先问清此后的血糖情况，并调阅这一阶段的床旁血糖记录。
need.en: First find out how her glucose has been since and read the bedside glucose record for this stage.

text.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路，趁血糖低先抽关键标本（不推迟治疗），10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg静推后持续输注并按血糖调整，继续喂养、频繁复测，目标>3.9 mmol/L
text.en: Place IV access, draw the critical sample while she is low (never delaying treatment), give 10% glucose 2 mL/kg IV then a continuous infusion adjusted to her glucose, keep feeding and recheck often, aiming above 3.9 mmol/L

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。低血糖一再出现就要静脉补糖：AAP 2011临床报告的做法是10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg（200 mg/kg）静推，并以5–8 mg/(kg·min)持续输注；2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南要求在低血糖时留取关键标本，但不能因此推迟治疗。疑似持续性低血糖症时，PES 2015把目标定在3.9 mmol/L（70 mg/dL）以上。
feedback.en: Right. Recurrent lows call for IV glucose: the AAP 2011 clinical report gives 10% glucose 2 mL/kg (200 mg/kg) followed by an infusion of 5–8 mg/kg/min, and the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline asks for the critical sample during the low without delaying treatment. Once a persistent disorder is suspected, PES 2015 sets the target above 3.9 mmol/L (70 mg/dL).

text.zh-CN: 生后头两天的低血糖多半是过渡期现象：先喂奶，并在颊黏膜涂葡萄糖凝胶，等下次喂奶前（约3小时后）再复测，出现发抖、抽搐等症状时再改为静脉补糖
text.en: Lows in the first two days are usually transitional: feed her and rub dextrose gel into her cheek now, recheck before the next feed in about 3 hours, and switch to IV glucose only if she becomes jittery or has a seizure

feedback.zh-CN: 喂养支持和葡萄糖凝胶是状态良好的婴儿出现轻度低血糖时的第一步（BAPM 2024足月儿低血糖框架）；低血糖一再出现，就需要静脉补糖并查找持续存在的原因（PES 2015）。等到出现发抖或抽搐才静脉补糖，等于等到大脑已经缺糖。
feedback.en: Feeding support and dextrose gel are the first step for a well baby with a mild low (BAPM 2024 term-infant framework); lows that keep recurring call for IV glucose and a search for a persisting cause (PES 2015). Waiting for jitteriness or a seizure means waiting until the brain is already short of glucose.

text.zh-CN: 先抽关键标本和静脉血糖送检，等化验室证实是真性低血糖、胰岛素和酮体结果也回来以后，再开始静脉补糖并持续输注，这样输入的葡萄糖不会干扰标本，诊断更可靠
text.en: Send the critical sample and a laboratory glucose first, and start IV glucose once the laboratory confirms true hypoglycaemia and the insulin result is back, so that infused glucose cannot spoil the sample and the diagnosis is more reliable

feedback.zh-CN: 等化验结果再补糖，会让她在低血糖中多停留数小时，增加脑损伤的风险。关键标本应在开始补糖前抽好，然后立即静脉补糖（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）；之后输入的葡萄糖改变不了已经抽出的标本。
feedback.en: Waiting for the laboratory leaves her hypoglycaemic for hours and risks brain injury. Draw the critical sample before the glucose goes in and then treat at once (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline); glucose given afterwards cannot change a sample already taken.

text.zh-CN: 用50%葡萄糖1–2 mL/kg快速静推，把血糖迅速拉上来，然后恢复按需喂养，下次喂奶前复测；只有再次降低时才考虑留置针持续输注
text.en: Give 50 % glucose 1–2 mL/kg as a rapid IV push to bring her glucose straight up, then return to feeds on demand and recheck before the next feed, keeping a continuous infusion for a further low

feedback.zh-CN: 新生儿不用50%葡萄糖：高渗液可致静脉炎，外渗后组织坏死；血糖骤升还会刺激胰岛素反跳、随后再次低血糖，胰岛素过多时尤其明显。静推应使用10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg，并随即持续输注（AAP 2011）。
feedback.en: Newborns are not given 50 % glucose: it is hyperosmolar, causes phlebitis and tissue necrosis if it leaks, and the sudden rise triggers rebound insulin release and a further low — worst when insulin is already in excess. Use 10% glucose 2 mL/kg followed at once by an infusion (AAP 2011).

prompt.zh-CN: 低血糖时的标本：血糖1.8 mmol/L，胰岛素11 μU/mL，C肽0.74 nmol/L，β-羟丁酸0.5 mmol/L；甲状腺功能和ACTH正常。这说明了什么？
prompt.en: The sample taken during a low: glucose 1.8 mmol/L, insulin 11 µU/mL, C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L, β-hydroxybutyrate 0.5 mmol/L; thyroid function and ACTH normal. What does this show?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅关键标本、甲状腺功能和ACTH的结果。
need.en: First read the critical sample, thyroid function and ACTH.

text.zh-CN: 胰岛素过多所致的低血糖：血糖1.8 mmol/L时胰岛素和C肽仍可测得、β-羟丁酸受抑制；血糖维持在3.9 mmol/L以上，过渡期后继续查病因并复查血氨
text.en: Hypoglycaemia from too much insulin: at 1.8 mmol/L insulin and C-peptide are still measurable and β-hydroxybutyrate is suppressed — keep glucose above 3.9 mmol/L, look for the cause beyond the transitional days and repeat the ammonia

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南：低血糖（<2.8 mmol/L）时β-羟丁酸<1.8 mmol/L、游离脂肪酸<1.7 mmol/L、注射胰高血糖素后血糖升高≥1.7 mmol/L提示高胰岛素血症，胰岛素可测得是支持证据。本例胰岛素11 μU/mL、C肽0.74 nmol/L、β-羟丁酸0.5 mmol/L；游离脂肪酸和胰高血糖素反应没有记录，血氨因单位存疑无法判读。采样日龄不详，生后48小时内的过渡期低血糖也会有同样的表现（PES 2015），所以关键在于低血糖是否持续到过渡期之后。
feedback.en: Right. By the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline, β-hydroxybutyrate < 1.8 mmol/L, free fatty acids < 1.7 mmol/L and a glucose rise ≥ 1.7 mmol/L after glucagon during hypoglycaemia (< 2.8 mmol/L) indicate hyperinsulinism, and measurable insulin supports it. Here insulin was 11 µU/mL, C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L and β-hydroxybutyrate 0.5 mmol/L; free fatty acids and a glucagon response are not recorded, and the ammonia cannot be read because its unit is doubtful. Her age at sampling is unknown and transitional hypoglycaemia in the first 48 hours looks the same (PES 2015), so what counts is whether the lows persist beyond that window.

text.zh-CN: 大体重新生儿的正常过渡：胰岛素11 μU/mL在常用的空腹参考范围内，生后头几天酮体本来就低，所以增加喂奶次数，预计在生后48–72小时内她会自己慢慢稳定下来
text.en: Normal transition in a big baby: an insulin of 11 µU/mL lies within the usual fasting reference range and ketones are always low in the first days, so feed her more often and expect her to settle by herself within 48–72 hours of birth

feedback.zh-CN: 判读要对照当时的血糖：血糖1.8 mmol/L时胰岛素本应被抑制，11 μU/mL“在空腹参考范围内”恰恰说明分泌不适当（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。过渡期低血糖可以有相同的生化表现，但她的低血糖一再出现、出生体重4.05 kg、母亲没有糖代谢异常，应按可能的持续性低血糖症评估（PES 2015）。
feedback.en: Read it against the glucose at the time: at 1.8 mmol/L insulin should be switched off, so an insulin of 11 µU/mL ‘within the fasting range’ is exactly what is inappropriate (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). Transitional hypoglycaemia can look the same biochemically, but her lows keep recurring, she weighed 4.05 kg and her mother had no glucose problem, so she needs assessment for a persistent disorder (PES 2015).

text.zh-CN: 脂肪酸氧化障碍：低血糖伴低酮体正是它的典型表现，所以送酰基肉碱谱、避免空腹、补充左卡尼汀，持续喂养到代谢结果回报，再决定是否需要其他检查
text.en: A fatty-acid oxidation disorder: hypoglycaemia with low ketones is its hallmark, so send acylcarnitines, avoid fasting, give carnitine and keep her on continuous feeds until the metabolic results return before any other test

feedback.zh-CN: 低酮性低血糖也见于脂肪酸氧化障碍，但那时胰岛素和C肽被抑制、游离脂肪酸升高；本例胰岛素和C肽都可测得，指向胰岛素过多（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。酰基肉碱谱可以作为补充鉴别，但不应因此偏离胰岛素过多这条主线。
feedback.en: Hypoketotic hypoglycaemia also occurs in fatty-acid oxidation disorders, but insulin and C-peptide are then suppressed and free fatty acids high; here both insulin and C-peptide were measurable, pointing to insulin excess (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). An acylcarnitine profile is a reasonable extra test, not a reason to leave that main line.

text.zh-CN: 垂体或肾上腺皮质功能不足：大体重婴儿反复低血糖，ACTH和甲状腺功能正常也不能排除，所以现在先用氢化可的松，同时在下次采血时补查皮质醇和生长激素
text.en: Pituitary or adrenal insufficiency: a normal ACTH and thyroid screen cannot exclude it in a big baby with recurrent lows, so start hydrocortisone now and add cortisol and growth hormone to the next blood samples

feedback.zh-CN: 新生儿垂体功能低下可以很像高胰岛素血症，所以关键标本要同时测皮质醇和生长激素（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）；本例只记录了ACTH和甲状腺功能正常。血糖1.8 mmol/L时胰岛素和C肽仍可测得，说明胰岛素过多是主要机制；没有证实缺乏就经验性用氢化可的松，会掩盖诊断并带来不良反应。
feedback.en: Hypopituitarism in a newborn can mimic hyperinsulinism, which is why the critical sample includes cortisol and growth hormone (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline); here only a normal ACTH and thyroid function are recorded. Measurable insulin and C-peptide at 1.8 mmol/L make insulin excess the main mechanism, and empirical hydrocortisone without a proven deficiency hides the diagnosis and adds side effects.

prompt.zh-CN: 工作诊断是胰岛素过多所致的低血糖。她的心脏超声示房间隔缺损、动脉导管未闭和轻度三尖瓣反流。药物治疗怎么开始？
prompt.en: The working diagnosis is hypoglycaemia from insulin excess. Her echocardiogram shows an atrial septal defect, a patent ductus arteriosus and mild tricuspid regurgitation. How do you start medical treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 2，并调阅心脏超声。
need.en: Answer decision 2 first and read the echocardiogram.

text.zh-CN: 口服二氮嗪，从5–15 mg/(kg·d)的低端起、分2–3次，合用噻嗪类利尿剂；调药期间继续静脉补糖，每天称重、记出入量、复查心超，数天后用院内禁食试验判断疗效
text.en: Oral diazoxide from the low end of 5–15 mg/kg/day in 2–3 doses with a thiazide; keep the IV glucose while the dose settles, weigh daily, chart fluids, repeat the echo, and judge the response by a supervised fast after several days

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南以二氮嗪为一线药物；美国儿科内分泌学会（PES）2020年的二氮嗪共识建议从剂量范围的低端起始、合用噻嗪类利尿剂，并监测水钠潴留、肺动脉高压和中性粒细胞减少。FDA 2015年的安全警示把先天性心脏病列为二氮嗪相关肺动脉高压的危险因素，她有房间隔缺损和动脉导管未闭，所以要复查心超。二氮嗪需要数天才能起效，疗效要在足量用药后用监护下的禁食试验判断。
feedback.en: Right. Diazoxide is first-line in the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline, and the 2020 Pediatric Endocrine Society consensus on diazoxide advises starting at the low end of the range with a thiazide alongside, and watching for fluid retention, pulmonary hypertension and neutropenia. The FDA's 2015 safety communication names congenital heart disease as a risk factor for diazoxide-associated pulmonary hypertension, and she has an ASD and a PDA, so the echo is repeated. Diazoxide takes days to work, so its effect is judged by a supervised fast at an adequate dose.

text.zh-CN: 口服二氮嗪直接用到15 mg/(kg·d)以求最快见效，用限液代替利尿剂，次日早上就停掉静脉补糖；如果用药第2天仍有低血糖，就判定二氮嗪无效，并马上联系外科安排手术
text.en: Oral diazoxide straight at 15 mg/kg/day for the quickest effect, fluid restriction instead of a diuretic and the IV glucose stopped next morning; any low on the second day proves diazoxide has failed, and surgery is booked at once

feedback.zh-CN: 一开始就用到15 mg/(kg·d)且不用利尿剂，水钠潴留和肺动脉高压的风险最高，对有房间隔缺损和动脉导管未闭的婴儿尤其危险（FDA 2015；PES 2020）。二氮嗪需要数天才能起效，第2天的一次低血糖不能证明无效；无效要在足量、足疗程后由监护下的禁食试验确认（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
feedback.en: Starting at 15 mg/kg/day without a diuretic carries the highest risk of fluid retention and pulmonary hypertension, especially with an ASD and a PDA (FDA 2015; PES 2020). Diazoxide takes days to act, so one low on day 2 proves nothing; failure is confirmed by a supervised fast after an adequate dose and time (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

text.zh-CN: 先用奥曲肽皮下注射，因为房间隔缺损和动脉导管未闭让二氮嗪的水钠潴留风险太大；奥曲肽逐步加量一周后仍有低血糖，再考虑加用二氮嗪，并请心脏科评估能否耐受
text.en: Octreotide injections first, because her ASD and PDA make diazoxide's fluid retention too dangerous; add diazoxide only if she still has lows after a week of octreotide at rising doses, once cardiology agrees she can tolerate it

feedback.zh-CN: 奥曲肽是二线药物：新生儿使用后有坏死性小肠结肠炎的报道（Laje等，Pediatr Diabetes 2010），疗效还会很快减弱。心脏问题意味着二氮嗪要合用利尿剂并严密监测，而不是跳过一线药物（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。
feedback.en: Octreotide is second-line: necrotising enterocolitis has been reported in newborns given it (Laje et al., Pediatr Diabetes 2010), and its effect wanes quickly. Her heart findings mean diazoxide with a diuretic and close monitoring, not skipping the first-line drug (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline).

text.zh-CN: 长期口服氢化可的松升高血糖，同时避免液体转移加重心脏负担；二氮嗪留作后备，等激素已不能把血糖维持在2.8 mmol/L以上时再用，届时再复查心超
text.en: Long-term hydrocortisone to lift her glucose while sparing her heart any fluid shifts, keeping diazoxide in reserve until the steroid can no longer hold her above 2.8 mmol/L, with a repeat echo at that point

feedback.zh-CN: 高胰岛素血症不是皮质醇缺乏，长期氢化可的松纠正不了胰岛素过多，却会带来感染、高血压和生长抑制；一线药物是二氮嗪（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。另外2.8 mmol/L这个下限太低：疑似持续性低血糖症时，目标应在3.9 mmol/L以上（PES 2015）。
feedback.en: Hyperinsulinism is not cortisol deficiency: long-term hydrocortisone cannot correct insulin excess and brings infection, hypertension and poor growth, while diazoxide is the first-line drug (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). And 2.8 mmol/L is too low a floor: with a suspected persistent disorder the target is above 3.9 mmol/L (PES 2015).

prompt.zh-CN: 用过二氮嗪和奥曲肽后，她仍频繁出现低血糖；此前的胰腺超声未见异常。下一步怎么办？
prompt.en: After diazoxide and octreotide she still has frequent lows; the earlier pancreatic ultrasound showed no abnormality. What next?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅药物治疗记录和此前的胰腺超声。
need.en: First read the treatment record and the earlier pancreatic ultrasound.

text.zh-CN: 按二氮嗪无效的高胰岛素血症处理：急查她和父母的ABCC8/KCNJ11，转诊有经验的专科中心，基因提示局灶型时做¹⁸F-DOPA PET，其间保证血糖安全
text.en: Treat it as diazoxide-unresponsive hyperinsulinism: urgent ABCC8/KCNJ11 testing of her and both parents, referral to an experienced centre, and ¹⁸F-DOPA PET if the genetics suggest focal disease, with IV glucose keeping her safe

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南：二氮嗪无效时尽快做ABCC8/KCNJ11等基因检测并同时检测父母，结果提示局灶型时行¹⁸F-DOPA PET定位，并转到有经验的高胰岛素血症中心。基因和PET结果出来之前，用静脉葡萄糖（必要时加用胰高血糖素）保证血糖安全。
feedback.en: Right. The 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline calls for rapid ABCC8/KCNJ11 testing with both parents once diazoxide fails, ¹⁸F-DOPA PET when the result suggests focal disease, and care at an experienced hyperinsulinism centre. Until the results are in, IV glucose (with glucagon if needed) keeps her safe.

text.zh-CN: 胰腺超声正常说明病变是弥漫型；与其让她靠静脉葡萄糖再等几周的基因结果，不如现在就安排近全胰切除（切除95%–98%），让她尽快摆脱反复低血糖和长期输液的痛苦
text.en: A normal pancreatic ultrasound means diffuse disease, so rather than keep her on IV glucose for weeks of genetic testing, arrange a near-total (95–98 %) pancreatectomy now and free her quickly from the lows and the drip

feedback.zh-CN: 超声、CT和MRI看不到新生儿的局灶病灶，超声正常不能说明是弥漫型（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。没有基因和PET结果就做近全胰切除，可能切掉一个本可局部切除治愈的病灶，并留下糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全。
feedback.en: Ultrasound, CT and MRI cannot see a newborn's focal lesion, so a normal ultrasound says nothing about diffuse disease (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). A near-total pancreatectomy without genetics and PET may remove a lesion that a limited resection could cure, and leaves diabetes and exocrine failure behind.

text.zh-CN: 先做胰腺增强CT和MRI寻找胰岛素瘤，看到肿块再请外科会诊；基因检测周期太长，对眼下的处理帮助不大，可以等结构影像结果出来、外科医生看过以后再决定要不要送检
text.en: Look for an insulinoma first with contrast CT and MRI of the pancreas and call the surgeons only if a mass is seen; genetic tests take too long to change what happens now and can wait until the imaging and the surgeons have had their say

feedback.zh-CN: 新生儿高胰岛素血症几乎不是胰岛素瘤；常规CT和MRI对局灶病灶不敏感，CT还有电离辐射。2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南的路径是快速基因检测加¹⁸F-DOPA PET，而不是用结构影像寻找肿块。
feedback.en: Neonatal hyperinsulinism is almost never an insulinoma; conventional CT and MRI miss focal lesions, and CT adds radiation. The 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline's route is rapid genetics plus ¹⁸F-DOPA PET, not a search for a mass on structural imaging.

text.zh-CN: 把奥曲肽加到最大剂量，白天和夜间都增加喂奶次数，教会家属用血糖仪后带回家，门诊复查时再根据家里记录的血糖决定是否需要进一步检查
text.en: Push octreotide to its maximum, add frequent day and night feeds, teach the family to use a glucose meter and send her home, deciding about further tests from the home readings at the clinic review

feedback.zh-CN: 药物无效、仍频繁低血糖时带血糖仪回家，等于让低血糖在家里发生，可致不可逆的脑损伤。出院前应证明她能在与年龄相应的禁食中维持安全的血糖（PES 2015），而现在连病因都还没有明确。
feedback.en: Sending her home on failed treatment with frequent lows moves the hypoglycaemia into the home and risks permanent brain injury. Before discharge she must show she can keep a safe glucose through an age-appropriate fast (PES 2015), and the cause is not even known yet.

prompt.zh-CN: 基因：患儿ABCC8 c.1792C>T，p.(Arg598*)，父母该位点均未检出；KCNJ11未见异常。¹⁸F-DOPA PET：胰体远端一个12.2 mm × 9.5 mm的病灶。你建议怎样治疗？
prompt.en: Genetics: ABCC8 c.1792C>T, p.(Arg598*) in her, not found at this position in either parent; no KCNJ11 abnormality. ¹⁸F-DOPA PET: a 12.2 × 9.5 mm lesion in the distal pancreatic body. What treatment do you advise?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅基因检测和PET报告。
need.en: First read the genetic and PET reports.

text.zh-CN: 很可能是局灶型：由有经验的小儿胰腺外科团队按¹⁸F-DOPA PET定位切除病灶（部分胰腺切除），术中冰冻切片确认切缘，术后禁食试验证实痊愈
text.en: Focal disease is likely: an experienced paediatric pancreatic team removes the PET-localised lesion (partial pancreatectomy), confirms clear margins on frozen sections and proves cure with a fast afterwards

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南：局灶型可以通过¹⁸F-DOPA PET引导的局部切除治愈，术中冰冻切片确认切缘，术后禁食试验证实痊愈。局灶型通常由一个父源的隐性KATP通道变异加上病灶内母源11p15区域缺失引起；本例变异在父母中都没有检出，可能是新发于父源染色体的变异，并不排除局灶型，PET和病理才能定论。
feedback.en: Right. By the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline, focal disease is cured by a PET-guided limited resection with frozen sections checking the margins, and a fast afterwards confirms cure. Focal lesions usually arise from one paternal recessive KATP-channel variant plus loss of the maternal 11p15 region within the lesion; a variant found in neither parent may have arisen new on the paternal chromosome, which does not exclude focal disease — the PET and the histology decide.

text.zh-CN: 做近全胰切除，把可能异常的胰岛都切掉：父母都没有的变异应按显性变异看待，可能累及整个胰腺，宁可术后用胰岛素也不要残留病灶
text.en: A near-total pancreatectomy to remove every possibly abnormal islet: a variant absent from both parents should be treated as dominant and may affect the whole gland, and later insulin is better than leaving disease behind

feedback.zh-CN: 近全胰切除（95%–98%）用于药物无效的弥漫型，术后常出现糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。p.(Arg598*)是无义（截短）变异，单个拷贝通常按隐性方式起作用，不会像显性变异那样累及整个胰腺；PET已定位病灶，应做局部切除。
feedback.en: Near-total (95–98 %) pancreatectomy is for medically unresponsive diffuse disease and commonly leaves diabetes and exocrine insufficiency (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). p.(Arg598*) is a nonsense (truncating) variant, and a single copy usually acts recessively rather than like a dominant variant across the gland; with a PET-localised lesion, a limited resection is the operation.

text.zh-CN: 变异不是从父亲遗传来的，局灶型就不可能，PET所见一定是假阳性：继续最大剂量的药物治疗，6个月后复查PET再决定是否需要手术
text.en: The variant was not inherited from her father, so focal disease is impossible and the PET finding must be a false positive: continue maximal medical treatment and repeat the PET in six months before deciding on surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 父母都没有检出，并不等于不可能是局灶型：变异可以新发于父源染色体，再加上病灶内母源11p15区域缺失，同样形成局灶病灶。¹⁸F-DOPA PET是定位局灶病灶的首选方法（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）；病灶明确时继续药物治疗，会让她长期暴露于低血糖。
feedback.en: Absent from both parents does not rule out focal disease: a variant can arise new on the paternal chromosome and, with loss of the maternal 11p15 region in the lesion, produce a focal lesion. ¹⁸F-DOPA PET is the method of choice for localisation (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline), and continuing drugs despite a clear lesion leaves her exposed to lows for months.

text.zh-CN: 只把PET上12.2 mm × 9.5 mm的结节剜除，不做冰冻切片，尽量缩短手术时间，保住每一毫米正常胰腺，术后靠反复监测血糖来判断是否已经切净
text.en: Enucleate only the 12.2 × 9.5 mm nodule seen on PET without frozen sections, keeping the operation short and sparing every millimetre of normal pancreas, and rely on glucose checks afterwards to show whether it all came out

feedback.zh-CN: 局灶病灶的实际范围可能大于影像所见，不做冰冻切片可能残留病变、术后仍低血糖（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）。手术应由有经验的胰腺外科团队完成，用冰冻切片确认切缘。
feedback.en: A focal lesion can extend beyond what the scan shows, and without frozen sections diseased tissue may be left behind and the lows continue (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline). The operation belongs to an experienced pancreatic team, with frozen sections confirming the margins.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病时间、出生经过（足月、分娩方式、有无窒息）、母亲孕期血糖和家族史，并追问此后的血糖变化
text.en: Elicited the onset, the birth (term, mode, asphyxia), the mother's glucose in pregnancy and the family history, and asked how her glucose had gone since

text.zh-CN: 追问低血糖时的表现、喂养方式和母亲孕产期用药（均无记录：问到本身就是能力）
text.en: Asked about her signs during the lows, her feeding and the mother's medicines in pregnancy and labour (none recorded — asking is the skill)

text.zh-CN: 对照胎龄评估出生体重，注意到体重超过4 kg
text.en: Assessed her birth weight against gestation and noted a weight over 4 kg

text.zh-CN: 低血糖反复出现时给予10%葡萄糖静脉推注并持续静脉输注
text.en: Gave an IV 10% glucose bolus and a continuous infusion while the lows were recurring

text.zh-CN: 在低血糖反复的阶段留取并调阅关键标本，调阅甲状腺功能、ACTH和心脏超声
text.en: Took and read the critical sample while the lows were recurring, and read thyroid function, ACTH and the echocardiogram

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择静脉补糖，并趁低血糖留取标本
text.en: Chose IV glucose with a sample taken during a low at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即从关键标本判断为胰岛素不适当分泌
text.en: Read the critical sample as inappropriate insulin secretion at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择低剂量起始的二氮嗪加噻嗪类利尿剂并监测肺动脉高压，且两种药都已开始
text.en: Chose low-start diazoxide with a thiazide and pulmonary-hypertension monitoring at the first attempt, and started both drugs

text.zh-CN: 药物无效后首次作答即选择急查基因（含父母）并转诊做定位检查，且已送检、已转诊
text.en: After the medicines failed, chose urgent genetics with both parents and referral for localisation at the first attempt, and sent the samples and the referral

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择PET引导、冰冻切片确认切缘的局部切除，并已安排手术
text.en: Chose a PET-guided limited resection with frozen-section margins at the first attempt, and arranged it

text.zh-CN: 没有做危险的处置：50%葡萄糖静推、经验性氢化可的松、在家禁食、近全胰切除，或未做禁食试验就出院
text.en: Avoided the dangerous steps: a 50 % glucose push, empirical hydrocortisone, a fast at home, near-total pancreatectomy, or discharge without a fasting check

text.zh-CN: 用家属听得懂的话解释低血糖的原因、检查和治疗选择，并确认对方理解
text.en: Explained the cause of the lows, the tests and the treatment choices in words the family understands, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge）：先问家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（例如会不会伤到脑子）；用日常语言解释“她的胰腺分泌了太多胰岛素，把血糖压得很低”，说明为什么要输葡萄糖、频繁测血糖、趁血糖低时抽血；解释二氮嗪的作用和需要留意的问题（浮肿、尿少、呼吸变快），以及为什么因为她心脏的情况要复查心超；药物无效时，说明为什么要抽她和父母双方的血查基因，为什么要做PET而不是普通CT或超声；讲清局部切除和近全胰切除的区别（后者以后很可能得糖尿病）以及术中冰冻切片的意义；坦诚说明三个月时血糖正常不等于以后发育一定没问题，需要定期随访；对父母都没有检出的变异，说明再生育的风险要由遗传咨询来评估；留出提问时间，用回授法确认理解。不堆砌术语，不承诺具体的治愈率或发育结局。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge): first asks what the family already knows and fears most (for example brain damage); explains in plain words that “her pancreas is making too much insulin, which drives her sugar very low”, and why she needs a glucose drip, frequent checks and a blood test taken while she is low; explains what diazoxide does and what to watch for (puffiness, less urine, faster breathing), and why her heart findings mean a repeat echo; when the medicines fail, explains why her blood and both parents' blood go for gene tests and why a PET scan rather than ordinary CT or ultrasound; makes clear the difference between removing only the affected part and removing most of the pancreas (the latter often leads to diabetes later) and what frozen sections are for; is honest that a normal glucose at three months does not guarantee normal development, so follow-up continues; for a variant found in neither parent, explains that the risk for a future baby needs genetic counselling; leaves time for questions and checks understanding by teach-back. Avoids jargon and promises no cure rate or developmental outcome.

name.zh-CN: 孟医生（新生儿科上级医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿科上级医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教、按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“第一次偏低可能只是过渡期，什么情况让你不再这样想？”“出生体重超过4 kg、母亲没有糖代谢异常，这两点合在一起提示什么？”“为什么要趁她还低的时候抽血，又为什么不能等结果再补糖？”“血糖很低时，胰岛素多少才算‘不该有’？”“开一种会引起水钠潴留的药之前和用药期间，你要查什么？”“什么时候才能说一种药无效？之后最急的是什么？”“超声正常为什么不能说明病变是弥漫的？”“父母的基因结果能说明什么、不能说明什么？”。说明这是2013年发表的历史病例：当年的用药剂量和手术细节本病例没有记录，记录下的病程不能当作现在的用药建议。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或结局；低血糖时的表现、喂养、阿氏评分、生命体征和查体、血氨数值、游离脂肪酸、皮质醇、生长激素、用药剂量、转诊年龄、手术细节和远期发育都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Neonatal attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “A first low may just be transition — what made you stop thinking that?”, “What do a birth weight over 4 kg and a mother with no glucose problem point to together?”, “Why draw blood while she is still low, and why not wait for the result before giving glucose?”, “At a very low glucose, how much insulin is too much?”, “What would you check before and during a drug that retains fluid?”, “When can you call a medicine a failure, and what is most urgent then?”, “Why does a normal ultrasound not make the disease diffuse?”, “What can the parents' genetic results tell you, and what can they not?”. Explains that this is a historical case published in 2013: the doses and operative details of the time are not recorded in this case, and the recorded course is no prescribing advice for today. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early; her signs during the lows, feeding, Apgar scores, vital signs and examination, the ammonia value, free fatty acids, cortisol, growth hormone, drug doses, age at referral, operative details and later development are not recorded — never supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 新生儿病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：生后11小时女婴，足月顺产，出生体重4.05 kg，出生时无窒息；刚刚发现血糖偏低；家属在床旁。可以协助：床旁测血糖并安排定时复测、建立静脉通路和采血（低血糖时先留标本）、用输液泵输注葡萄糖、喂奶、送检标本、记录体重和出入量。给药前核对葡萄糖浓度，提醒新生儿用10%而不是50%的葡萄糖；复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（如生命体征、具体血糖数值、喂养情况）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Neonatal ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): girl aged 11 hours, born at term by vaginal delivery, birth weight 4.05 kg, no asphyxia at birth; her glucose has just been found to be low; a relative is at the cot side. Can help with bedside glucose checks and a recheck schedule, IV access and bloods (the sample first while she is low), glucose on an infusion pump, feeds, sending samples, and weight and fluid charts. Checks the glucose concentration before giving it and reminds the team that newborns get 10%, not 50 %; reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (vital signs, individual glucose values, her feeding).

name.zh-CN: 钱医生（儿童内分泌科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童内分泌科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的结果。可以讲：2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南的诊断要点（低血糖时β-羟丁酸<1.8 mmol/L、游离脂肪酸<1.7 mmol/L、胰高血糖素反应≥1.7 mmol/L，胰岛素可测得是支持证据）和疑似持续性低血糖症时>3.9 mmol/L的目标（PES 2015）；过渡期低血糖与持续性低血糖的区别；二氮嗪的用法、合用利尿剂和疗效判断（院内监护下的禁食试验）；二氮嗪无效时尽快做基因检测并检测父母；局灶型的机制（父源隐性KATP通道变异加病灶内母源11p15缺失，新发变异也可能发生在父源染色体上），以及¹⁸F-DOPA PET的指征；变异按HGVS规范命名。不提前给出决策答案或结局，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric endocrinology consultant who interprets only results the learner has already read. Can explain the 2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline's diagnostic features (during hypoglycaemia β-hydroxybutyrate < 1.8 mmol/L, free fatty acids < 1.7 mmol/L, a glucagon response ≥ 1.7 mmol/L, with measurable insulin as support) and the target above 3.9 mmol/L once a persistent disorder is suspected (PES 2015); transitional versus persistent hypoglycaemia; how diazoxide is given with a diuretic and how its effect is judged (a supervised fast in hospital); rapid genetic testing with both parents when diazoxide fails; the focal mechanism (a paternal recessive KATP-channel variant plus loss of the maternal 11p15 region in the lesion — a new variant can also arise on the paternal chromosome) and the indications for ¹⁸F-DOPA PET; HGVS naming of variants. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 秦医生（影像与核医学科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 影像与核医学科医生，只解读学员已经看过的影像报告。可以讲：常规超声、CT和MRI通常看不到新生儿胰腺内的局灶病灶，所以结构影像正常不能排除局灶型；¹⁸F-DOPA PET是定位局灶病灶的首选方法，可以指导手术切除的部位，但病灶的真实范围仍要靠术中冰冻切片和病理确认；有创的静脉采血定位方法已被PET取代。不提前透露诊断或结局，不补充本病例没有记录的数值（如摄取值）。
knowledge.en: Radiology and nuclear medicine doctor who interprets only imaging the learner has already read. Can explain that conventional ultrasound, CT and MRI usually cannot see a focal lesion in a newborn's pancreas, so normal structural imaging does not exclude focal disease; that ¹⁸F-DOPA PET is the method of choice to localise a focal lesion and guide where to operate, while its true extent is still confirmed by frozen sections and histology; and that invasive venous-sampling localisation has been replaced by PET. Never reveals the diagnosis or the outcome early and adds no figure the case does not record (such as uptake values).

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，负责用药安全。可以讲：新生儿静推葡萄糖用10%（2 mL/kg），不用50%；糖速的计算方法；二氮嗪5–15 mg/(kg·d)、分2–3次、从低端起始（PES 2020），常见问题是水钠潴留和多毛，严重的是肺动脉高压和中性粒细胞减少，FDA 2015年警示先天性心脏病是肺动脉高压的危险因素，所以要合用噻嗪类利尿剂、每天称体重、复查心超和血象；奥曲肽是二线药物，新生儿有坏死性小肠结肠炎的报道，疗效会减弱；胰高血糖素可用于急救或过渡；没有证实皮质醇缺乏就不用激素升血糖。本病例没有记录当年的剂量，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist responsible for medication safety. Can explain that newborns get 10% glucose (2 mL/kg) as a bolus, never 50 %; how the glucose infusion rate is calculated; that diazoxide is 5–15 mg/kg/day in 2–3 doses starting at the low end (PES 2020), with fluid retention and excess hair as common effects and pulmonary hypertension and neutropenia as serious ones, congenital heart disease being a risk factor for pulmonary hypertension in the FDA's 2015 warning — hence a thiazide, daily weights, a repeat echo and blood counts; that octreotide is second-line, with necrotising enterocolitis reported in newborns and a waning effect; that glucagon serves as rescue or as a bridge; and that steroids are not used to raise glucose without a proven cortisol deficiency. The case does not record the doses used at the time — never supply them.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：反复新生儿低血糖与局灶型先天性高胰岛素血症
title.en: Debrief: recurrent neonatal hypoglycaemia from focal congenital hyperinsulinism

conclusion.zh-CN: 足月顺产女婴，出生体重4.05 kg，无窒息，母亲孕期无糖耐量异常，父母非近亲。生后11小时出现低血糖，此后多次低于2.8 mmol/L。低血糖时标本：血糖1.8 mmol/L，胰岛素11 μU/mL，C肽0.74 nmol/L，β-羟丁酸0.5 mmol/L，提示胰岛素过多；甲状腺功能和ACTH正常，胰腺超声和头颅及垂体MRI未见异常，心脏超声示房间隔缺损、动脉导管未闭和轻度三尖瓣反流。用过二氮嗪和奥曲肽仍频繁低血糖。患儿ABCC8 c.1792C>T，p.(Arg598*)，父母该位点均未检出，KCNJ11未见异常；¹⁸F-DOPA定位胰体远端12.2 mm×9.5 mm病灶。局灶部分切除后病理证实为局灶型，三个月时空腹血糖约4.4–6.0 mmol/L、餐后约7 mmol/L。现行做法：低血糖反复时立即静脉补糖并在低血糖时留取标本，二氮嗪合用利尿剂并监测肺动脉高压，无效时急查基因（含父母）并转诊做¹⁸F-DOPA PET，按PET做局部切除并用冰冻切片确认切缘，长期随访神经发育。
conclusion.en: A term girl of 4.05 kg (vaginal birth, no asphyxia; unrelated parents; mother without glucose intolerance) was hypoglycaemic from 11 hours, with repeated readings below 2.8 mmol/L. A sample during a low showed glucose 1.8 mmol/L, insulin 11 µU/mL, C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L and β-hydroxybutyrate 0.5 mmol/L: insulin excess. Thyroid function, ACTH, pancreatic ultrasound and brain/pituitary MRI were unremarkable; the echo showed an ASD, a PDA and mild tricuspid regurgitation. Lows continued on diazoxide and octreotide. ABCC8 c.1792C>T, p.(Arg598*) was found in her but in neither parent, with no KCNJ11 abnormality; ¹⁸F-DOPA localised a 12.2 × 9.5 mm lesion in the distal pancreatic body. A partial resection confirmed focal disease; at three months fasting glucose was about 4.4–6.0 mmol/L. Today: prompt IV glucose and a critical sample, diazoxide with a thiazide and a pulmonary-hypertension watch, urgent genetics with both parents, PET, a guided resection with frozen sections, and follow-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第一次偏低可能只是过渡期，但血糖一再低于2.8 mmol/L，又是体重4.05 kg、母亲没有糖代谢异常的婴儿，说明问题会持续：现在就静脉补糖，并趁低血糖抽血。
keyReasoning.en: A first low may be transitional, but lows that keep recurring below 2.8 mmol/L in a 4.05 kg baby whose mother had no glucose problem point to a persisting cause: treat with IV glucose now and draw blood during a low.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖1.8 mmol/L时，任何可测到的胰岛素都不该有：胰岛素11 μU/mL、C肽0.74 nmol/L加上β-羟丁酸只有0.5 mmol/L，说明胰岛素在压低血糖、同时关掉了脂肪和酮体这条备用燃料。
keyReasoning.en: At a glucose of 1.8 mmol/L any measurable insulin is too much: insulin 11 µU/mL and C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L with β-hydroxybutyrate of only 0.5 mmol/L mean insulin is driving the low and switching off the back-up fuel of fat and ketones.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 甲状腺功能和ACTH正常、母亲没有糖耐量异常，使垂体问题和糖尿病母亲婴儿的解释都不像主因；但皮质醇、生长激素和血氨仍是空白，要如实标出。
keyReasoning.en: Normal thyroid function and ACTH and a mother without glucose intolerance make a pituitary cause or an infant-of-a-diabetic-mother picture unlikely to be the main story — yet cortisol, growth hormone and the ammonia remain blanks to be named.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 用过二氮嗪和奥曲肽仍频繁低血糖，问题就变成局灶还是弥漫：这要靠基因和¹⁸F-DOPA PET回答，超声和MRI回答不了。
keyReasoning.en: Frequent lows despite diazoxide and octreotide turn the question into focal or diffuse — answered by genetics and ¹⁸F-DOPA PET, not by ultrasound or MRI.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一个父母都没有的截短型ABCC8变异，加上PET上12.2 mm×9.5 mm的病灶，符合发生在父源染色体上的新发变异所致的局灶型；局部切除并用冰冻切片确认切缘可以治愈，病理也证实了局灶型。
keyReasoning.en: A truncating ABCC8 variant found in neither parent, with a 12.2 × 9.5 mm lesion on PET, fits focal disease from a new variant on the paternal chromosome; a limited resection with frozen-section margins can cure it, and the histology confirmed the focal form.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 三个月时血糖正常只是短期结果：神经发育、是否复发和胰腺功能都没有记录，随访和遗传咨询仍然需要。
keyReasoning.en: Normal glucose at three months is a short-term result: neurodevelopment, recurrence and pancreatic function are unrecorded, and follow-up and genetic counselling are still needed.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2013年发表的单例报告，不能用来比较治疗方法或估计预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；当年的补糖方式、用药剂量、手术细节和远期结局没有记录，病例也不模拟任何生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2013: it cannot compare treatments or set a prognosis. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; how glucose was given, the drug doses, the operative details and the long-term outcome are not recorded, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各次低血糖的具体数值和时间、低血糖时的表现、喂养方式和奶量，以及当年是否静脉补糖、糖速多少。
unknowns.en: The values and times of the lows, her signs during them, how and how much she was fed, and whether IV glucose was given and at what glucose infusion rate.

unknowns.zh-CN: 具体孕周、阿氏评分、母亲孕产期用药和产时是否输葡萄糖；出生体重的百分位。
unknowns.en: The exact gestation in weeks, Apgar scores, the mother's medicines in pregnancy and labour and any intrapartum glucose drip; her birth-weight centile.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院查体：生命体征、神经系统表现、面容或过度生长的体征、心脏杂音。
unknowns.en: The admission examination: vital signs, neurological state, facial or overgrowth features, any heart murmur.

unknowns.zh-CN: 关键标本采集时的日龄；游离脂肪酸、乳酸、皮质醇、生长激素和胰高血糖素反应；血氨的数值和原单位。
unknowns.en: Her age when the critical sample was taken; free fatty acids, lactate, cortisol, growth hormone and the glucagon response; the ammonia value and its original unit.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 最初几小时：低血糖一再出现就静脉补糖——10%葡萄糖2 mL/kg（200 mg/kg）静推，再以5–8 mg/(kg·min)持续输注（AAP 2011），趁低血糖先留关键标本，但绝不因此推迟治疗（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）；疑似持续性低血糖症时目标>3.9 mmol/L（PES 2015）。本例生后11小时起病，此后多次低于2.8 mmol/L，出生体重4.05 kg，母亲无糖耐量异常；本病例没有记录当年如何补糖。
teachingPoints.en: The first hours: recurrent lows need IV glucose — 10% glucose 2 mL/kg (200 mg/kg), then 5–8 mg/kg/min by infusion (AAP 2011) — with the critical sample drawn during the low but never at the cost of delay (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline); once a persistent disorder is suspected, the target is above 3.9 mmol/L (PES 2015). Here the lows began at 11 hours and recurred below 2.8 mmol/L in a 4.05 kg baby whose mother had no glucose intolerance; this case does not record how glucose was given at the time.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 关键标本的判读（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）：血糖<2.8 mmol/L时β-羟丁酸<1.8 mmol/L、游离脂肪酸<1.7 mmol/L、胰高血糖素反应≥1.7 mmol/L提示胰岛素过多，胰岛素可测得是支持证据。本例血糖1.8 mmol/L、胰岛素11 μU/mL、C肽0.74 nmol/L、β-羟丁酸0.5 mmol/L；游离脂肪酸、皮质醇、生长激素和胰高血糖素反应没有记录，血氨单位存疑。生后48小时内的过渡期低血糖可有相同表现（PES 2015），所以要看低血糖是否持续。
teachingPoints.en: Reading the critical sample (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline): at a glucose < 2.8 mmol/L, β-hydroxybutyrate < 1.8 mmol/L, free fatty acids < 1.7 mmol/L and a glucagon response ≥ 1.7 mmol/L indicate insulin excess, and measurable insulin supports it. Here glucose 1.8 mmol/L, insulin 11 µU/mL, C-peptide 0.74 nmol/L and β-hydroxybutyrate 0.5 mmol/L; free fatty acids, cortisol, growth hormone and a glucagon response are not recorded, and the ammonia unit is doubtful. Transitional hypoglycaemia in the first 48 hours can look the same (PES 2015), so persistence is what counts.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 二氮嗪的安全使用：一线药物（2024年国际指南），5–15 mg/(kg·d)分2–3次、从低端起、合用噻嗪类利尿剂并监测水钠潴留、肺动脉高压和中性粒细胞（PES 2020）；FDA 2015年警示先天性心脏病是二氮嗪相关肺动脉高压的危险因素，她有房间隔缺损和动脉导管未闭。疗效用院内监护下的禁食试验判断，绝不在家禁食。奥曲肽是二线药物，新生儿有坏死性小肠结肠炎的报道（Laje 2010）。报告记录用过两药仍频繁低血糖；本病例没有收录剂量，是否合用利尿剂也没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Using diazoxide safely: first-line (2024 international guideline), 5–15 mg/kg/day in 2–3 doses starting low, with a thiazide and monitoring for fluid retention, pulmonary hypertension and neutropenia (PES 2020); the FDA's 2015 warning names congenital heart disease as a risk factor for diazoxide-associated pulmonary hypertension, and she had an ASD and a PDA. Response is judged by a supervised fast in hospital, never at home. Octreotide is second-line, with necrotising enterocolitis reported in newborns (Laje 2010). The report records frequent lows on both drugs; this case does not include the doses, and whether a diuretic was given is not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 二氮嗪无效之后（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）：急查ABCC8/KCNJ11并同时检测父母；局灶型通常是父源的单个隐性KATP通道变异加病灶内母源11p15缺失，基因提示局灶型时做¹⁸F-DOPA PET；超声、CT和MRI正常不能排除局灶病灶。本例变异按HGVS写作c.1792C>T，p.(Arg598*)（报告写作p.Arg598X），父母均未检出，可能是新发于父源染色体的变异；PET定位胰体远端12.2 mm×9.5 mm病灶。
teachingPoints.en: After diazoxide fails (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline): urgent ABCC8/KCNJ11 testing with both parents; focal disease usually means one paternal recessive KATP-channel variant plus loss of the maternal 11p15 region in the lesion, and genetics suggesting focal disease lead to ¹⁸F-DOPA PET; normal ultrasound, CT or MRI cannot exclude a focal lesion. Here the variant, in HGVS form c.1792C>T, p.(Arg598*) (written p.Arg598X in the report), was in neither parent and may have arisen new on the paternal chromosome; PET localised a 12.2 × 9.5 mm lesion in the distal pancreatic body.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 手术选择（2024年国际高胰岛素血症指南）：局灶型按PET做局部切除，术中冰冻切片确认切缘，术后禁食试验证实痊愈；近全胰切除（95%–98%）只留给药物无效的弥漫型，常留下糖尿病和胰腺外分泌功能不全。本例做了局灶部分切除，病理证实局灶型，三个月时空腹血糖约4.4–6.0 mmol/L、餐后约7 mmol/L；本病例没有记录冰冻切片和切缘。
teachingPoints.en: Choosing the operation (2024 international hyperinsulinism guideline): focal disease is removed by a PET-guided limited resection with frozen-section margins and a fast afterwards to prove cure; near-total (95–98 %) pancreatectomy is kept for medically unresponsive diffuse disease and often leaves diabetes and exocrine insufficiency. Here a focal partial resection was done and histology confirmed focal disease; at three months fasting glucose was about 4.4–6.0 mmol/L and post-meal about 7 mmol/L; this case does not record frozen sections or margins.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 随访与沟通：中华医学会儿科学分会新生儿学组的共识（2021）强调早期规范管理可减少低血糖所致的脑损伤；短期血糖正常不代表神经发育正常，要定期评估发育，并用禁食试验确认痊愈。父母均未检出的变异使再生育的风险评估需要遗传咨询，用Calgary–Cambridge的方式把这些讲清楚。本例没有记录远期发育、复发、胰腺功能和遗传咨询。
teachingPoints.en: Follow-up and the family: the 2021 consensus of the Chinese Medical Association's neonatology group stresses that early, standardised management reduces hypoglycaemic brain injury; a normal short-term glucose does not mean normal development, so development is followed and cure is confirmed by a fast. A variant found in neither parent means the risk for a future baby needs genetic counselling, explained in the Calgary–Cambridge way. This case records no long-term development, recurrence, pancreatic function or counselling.
